articles.title: Dallas Startup AI Hospitality Group Raises $7.5M to Manage Hotels With AI Agents
articles.summary: Dallas entrepreneur Sloan Dean saw a problem with the hospitality industry’s operating model and set out to help fix it with AI. The result: AI Hospitality Group, a new startup that calls itself an AI-native hotel operator. The company, which recently launched, said its 60-plus back-office AI agents free up on-property staff to concentrate on in-person customer service.…

articles.title: Texas Tech leaders face questions over their role in Ken Paxton U.S. Senate race fundraiser
articles.summary: Chancellor Brandon Creighton and Cody Campbell, who chairs Tech's Board of Regents, are identified by their official university titles on the invitation to the Sept. 29 fundraiser. Lubbock County Democrats are questioning whether their public positions — or university resources — were used to promote the event.

articles.title: New funding supports AI safety research and training at UT San Antonio
articles.summary: A newly funded UT San Antonio research project aims to teach students how to identify and fix security vulnerabilities in AI-generated code, with a focus on making increasingly autonomous AI agents safer.
